notes: USMC Operations vol. I, Part VI, ch. 5, and Appendix C: on 3 September 1942 the command echelon of the 1st Marine Aircraft Wing arrived, including Brigadier General Roy S. Geiger. Geiger established his command post near General Vandegrift and used the MAG-23 staff as his wing staff. Confidence 0.5, one official family.
